observations: body L1-L4: Schiaparelli's addition on the figure of p. 64, begun on p. 237, goes on here; a heavy bracket closes it in L4, after a dash of 9.7 pt.
body L3, L7, L18, L25, L30: the dashes of «al–Battānī» are long dashes (4.3 to 5.5 pt; the shortest in L7).
body L3, L9, L17, L31: the dashes of «64–65», «17–19», «dit–il» and «65–66» are long dashes (5.2 to 5.8 pt).
body L5, L15: in the heads the dashes after «b)» and «c)» measure 10.3 and 10.0 pt; those of «17–23» and «23–34» are long dashes.

body L6-L14: heavy brackets open and close Schiaparelli's addition b); the dashes after the quotation (L6), after «17–19.» (L9) and before his name (L14) measure 9.7 to 10.4 pt, as do those of L20 and L26.
body L6: five dots follow «est» in the quotation of p. 65.

body L8-L13: the equalities are checked: the third of L13 is the sum of the first two, and with Δε negative and greater in size than Δm, Δl = Δm + Δε is negative, as L8-L9 say. The signs of equality print 9.4 to 9.7 pt long and the signs of addition 9.3 to 10.7 pt wide.
body L13: the line of equalities is centred in the print; its three parts stand at their printed places.
body L1-L2, L32, L34: specks before «Demonstratio», over the o of «corre-», before «suis» and before «solitus» are not transcribed.
body L3, L27, L30: the t of «fortasse» and of «tangentium» print without their bars, so that they look like l, and the t of «proveniunt» is broken.
notes L1: the only note is set in one line across the page.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
